主要内容: McDermott International Inc., a Houston-based company that builds oil platforms and gas-export plants for energy producers, is reportedly preparing to file for bankruptcy as soon as next week to address its more than $4 billion debt load. According to individuals with knowledge of the matter, the company is negotiating a restructuring plan that could convert its debt into equity. Existing term-loan lenders are expected to receive the majority of the shares, while unsecured creditors would get less than 10% of the equity along with warrants.
